definitions.explanation: A journey to a destination and back; travel in both directions.
Movement or communication going back and forth repeatedly.

notes:
USAGE: {往復|おうふく} is commonly used for transportation and travel.

COMPOUNDS:
- {往復|おうふく}⟦{切符|きっぷ}→切符：00643_kippu⟧ (round-trip ticket)
- {往復|おうふく}⟦{運賃|うんちん}→運賃：05299_unchin⟧ (round-trip fare)
- {往復|おうふく}⟦はがき→はがき：00699_hagaki⟧ (return postcard - has reply section attached)
- {往復|おうふく}⟦{書簡|しょかん}→書簡：20091_shokan⟧ (correspondence, exchange of letters)

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {往復|おうふく}で〜 (round trip, takes ~)
- {往復|おうふく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to make a round trip)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{片道|かたみち}→片道：00199_katamichi⟧ - one way (opposite)
